**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 3 (every old goal is read), batches 1 to 10 are done.** `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal on the chain from `core-depth` to `core-zip` (`data/chain.json:170`), in `## Decisions` or the closing `## Goals with nothing to keep` list. Stage 3's check stays red until every goal in front of `goal-closeout` is named there. The remaining 17 goals are batch 11 (`tools-cli` to `ci-green`). Each one is hand-written, has a `## Standing decisions` section of 3 to 12 bullets and a handoff `backlog` of 1 to 3 items.

A `bun -e` one-liner over `data/chain.json` and `data/goals/<slug>.handoff.json` prints a batch's backlogs and counts each goal's standing decisions in one call. The guard denies a `grep` over `data/goals/*.json`. A Rust heap allocation made during a request is charged to that request by the global allocator (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs` module doc), so a backlog item saying a `Vec` in `Ctx` "charges no budget" is stale.

Gaps owned by `goal-closeout`, and opened by this stage, all under `data/gaps/`: `nv/no-suite-runs-the-proof-programs-once-the-floor-is-gone`, `nv/tool-surfaces-checked-only-by-the-floor`, `nv/the-tsan-check-s-crate-keying-has-no-test`, `nv/data-schema-is-promised-and-nothing-writes-it`, `website/the-website-grammar-is-hand-written-beside-the-editors`, `nvs-stdlib/reference-cards-are-not-held-to-the-plain-voice`, `nvs-stdlib/csv-parse-refuses-a-tainted-document`, `nvs-stdlib/core-server-has-no-request-environment-or-trace-id`, `benches/member-benches-index-with-a-uint`, `nvs-stdlib/the-topic-table-has-no-ceiling-of-its-own`, `nvs-stdlib/a-topic-re-subscribe-allocates`, `nvs-stdlib/zip-extraction-creates-a-file-by-path-after-resolving-its-folder`. Stage 4 sorts them into done and too large.

`bun nv import` is broken, because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6. That is expected.

items.text: **Batch 11a, standing decisions** — `data/chain.json:171` to `data/chain.json:187`, from `tools-cli` to `ci-green`. Send two `Explore` subagents at once, about nine goals each. Each reads `docs/agent/goals/<slug>.md` § *Standing decisions* and returns, per bullet, the `file:line` of a rule fragment, decision record, module doc, reference page or test that states it, or "no home". Check each "no home" yourself, then write it as an entry under `## Decisions` in `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md:12`, or as a gap when it is work not built.

**Batch 11b, backlogs, then the closing list** — the same seventeen goals. Check each handoff `backlog` item against the tree, fix a stale sentence in place, write a gap owned by `goal-closeout` for work still owed, and add each slug with nothing to keep to the closing list at `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md:36`. Several items name a file and line already, for example `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/mod.rs:561` (`limit-handler-reach`) and `crates/nvs-types/tests/common/mod.rs` (`path-literals-follow-up`).
